mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, we are looking at 83 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Area High School. The moon phase is a Waning Gibbous.

The city has two main updates today. First, September is officially Hunger Action Month to combat local food insecurity. Additionally, expect some traffic delays on Highway M on August 31 and September 1 due to flaggers assisting with utility construction.
There is plenty to do in Verona today, including the Verona Area Kids Triathlon, live music at Bailey's Run, and Girls Try Hockey at the arena. Tomorrow, you can check out Yoga at Insight Wellness.
In a noteworthy call from August 21, an officer conducted a traffic stop for expired registration and cited the driver for possession of marijuana.
The flavor of the day is Crazy for Cookie Dough. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
